facts.fact: PReSE, EU-financed and implemented by Camoes, is developing through the Universidade de Aveiro an automatic and permanent electoral registration system, with staff trained to maintain it.
facts.system: sistema de recenseamento eleitoral automatico e permanente

facts.fact: The article says the platform's core is interoperability between the civil register database (SIGA and Bilhete de Identidade) and the electoral register database, enabling automatic voter enrolment.
